title_zh: 把五金店当成猫咪咖啡馆
title_en: Funny Stories from Life (15/20): Mistaking a Hardware Store for a Cat Café
note_en: 以为 means "to think (wrongly)": 以为这是网上很火的猫咪主题咖啡馆 "she thought it was the cat café that was so popular online," and it wasn't. English "thought" can be right or wrong, but Chinese 以为 almost always signals a mistaken belief, while 认为 is used for a considered opinion.
